scope: The five physical pages listed in workflow-live-evaluation.md; these expectations were written before reviewing model extraction or analytical output.
units_of_assessment: Seven grouped evidence cases. A case passes only when every listed critical distinction survives; partially recovered cases are reported separately.

Conditional on international financing for best available technologies
Separate target variant from the unconditional 35%
1990 inventory: 137.8 million tonnes CO2-eq excluding LULUCF
1990 inventory: 117.2 million tonnes CO2-eq including LULUCF
2018 is the projections/policy-accounting base, not the mitigation-target base
Council of Ministers decision 6 November 2025 No. 614
NDC for 2026–2035
Recounted historical 28% pledge is not newly adopted merely because repeated
At least 42% unconditional reduction by 2035 against 1990, including LULUCF
At least 47% conditional reduction by 2035 against 1990, including LULUCF
Preserved forest/ecosystem absorption capacity condition
Access to international carbon markets condition
Exit from international sanctions condition retained as a source statement
External financial, capacity-building, technical and technology-transfer support conditions
GDP energy-intensity reduction range 22–25%
